+func ExecutePricingScript(script string, ctx map[string]float64) (float64, error) {
+	L := lua.NewState()
+	defer L.Close()
+
+	if err := L.DoString(script); err != nil {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute lua script: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	calcFn := L.GetGlobal("calculate_final_price")
+	if calcFn.Type() != lua.LTFunction {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("calculate_final_price is not a function (got %s)", calcFn.Type().String())
+	}
+
+	ctxTable := L.NewTable()
+	for k, v := range ctx {
+		L.SetField(ctxTable, k, lua.LNumber(v))
+	}
+
+	if err := L.CallByParam(lua.P{
+		Fn:      calcFn,
+		NRet:    1,
+		Protect: true,
+	}, ctxTable); err != nil {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("error calling calculate_final_price: %w", err)
+	}

+	result := L.Get(-1)

+
+	if result.Type() != lua.LTNumber {

+	}
